items.title: 3.9 Bond energy aur bond length (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.9, printed pages 67-69, with Quick Check 3.10.

blocks.title: Bond energy
blocks.text: Bond energy woh average energy hai jo kisi substance ke ek mole mein ek khas qism ke sab bonds torne ke liye chahiye.

Yeh experiment se maloom hoti hai: chemical reaction mein nikalne ya lagne wali heat napi jati hai. Is ki unit kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Bond energy bond ki mazbooti aur us ki reactivity ka naap hai. Bond ki mazbooti in cheezon par depend karti hai:

items: Bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq

blocks.text: Kuch bonds ki bond energies (enthalpies) Table 3.2 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 3.2 Kuch bonds ki average bond energies, kJ mol⁻¹ (sahi kiya hua)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Table 3.2 mein 615 kJ mol⁻¹ ko C≡N (triple bond) ke saamne likha hai. 615 asal mein C=N (double bond) ki value hai; C≡N is se mazboot hai, taqreeban 891 kJ mol⁻¹. Upar table mein C=N likha gaya hai.

Ab electronegativity ke farq ka kirdar dekhein. H–X qism ke compounds (X = F, Cl, Br, I) ki bond energies dekhein. Data batata hai ke bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq jitna barhta hai, bond energy utni barhti hai. Farq barhne se bond ki polarity barhti hai, aur yeh atoms ko jorne ke liye extra kashish (attraction) deti hai. Isi liye HF ki bond energy (565 kJ mol⁻¹) HI (295 kJ mol⁻¹) se zyada hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke multiple bonds ki energy single bonds se zyada hoti hai:

blocks.title: Bond length
blocks.text: Bond length covalent bond banane wale do atoms ke nuclei ke darmiyan fasla (distance) hai.

Bond length physical techniques se napi jati hai, jaise electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction ya spectra ka mutala (spectral studies). Bond length kai cheezon par depend karti hai: electronegativity, size aur covalent bond ki qism (single, double ya triple). Kuch bond lengths Table 3.3 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 3.3 Kuch bonds ki bond lengths

blocks.text: Atoms ka size barhne se covalent bond length bhi barhti hai. C–Cl bond length taqreeban 180 pm hai, jabke C–F 135 pm, kyun ke Cl atom bohat bara hai. Bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq barhne se bond chhota ho jata hai. Maslan SiF₄ mein Si–F bond length taqreeban 155 pm napi gayi, jabke Si aur F ke covalent radii (Si = 117 pm, F = 64 pm) jor kar 181 pm aati hai. Electronegativity ka farq covalent bond mein kuch ionic character le aata hai, aur yeh ionic character atoms ke darmiyan extra kashish de kar bond ko chhota kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt: HI zyada strong acid aur achha reducing agent hai, jabke HF kamzor acid. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: H–I bond energy sirf 295 kJ mol⁻¹ hai aur H–F ki 565 kJ mol⁻¹. H–I bond aasani se toot jata hai: HI aasani se H⁺ deta hai (strong acid) aur apna hydrogen ya electrons aasani se deta hai (reducing agent). Mazboot H–F bond hydrogen ko pakre rakhta hai, is liye HF kamzor acid hai.

blocks.prompt: Acetylene (HC≡CH) ethene (H₂C=CH₂) se zyada stable kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: C≡C bond (839 kJ mol⁻¹) C=C (614 kJ mol⁻¹) se mazboot aur chhota hai (120 pm banam 133 pm), is liye acetylene ka carbon-carbon bond torne ke liye zyada energy chahiye. (Kitab ne ethene ko 'HC=CH' likha hai; sahi formula H₂C=CH₂ hai.)

items: Bond energy (kJ mol⁻¹) ek mole bonds torne ki average energy hai aur mazbooti batati hai; electronegativity farq ke saath barhti hai (HF 565 > HI 295) aur bond ki tadaad ke saath bhi (C≡C 839 > C=C 614 > C–C 347).
Bond length (pm) nuclei ka fasla hai; atom ka size barhne se barhti hai (C–F 135, C–Cl 180, C–I 214) aur electronegativity farq barhne se ghatti hai (Si–F 155 napi hui, radii se 181).
